tools.description: Server/compiler identity, pinned XAX revision, targets, operations, carrier types, I/O modes, granted rights, sandbox status and honest maturity labels. Call first.
tools.name: xax_capabilities
tools.title: XAX capabilities

tools.description: PROTOTYPE: describes the current store (the root bytes recorded in its header and its byte size). The workspace handle lifecycle (open/list/describe/close) is not implemented by the native server yet; the store is the host-granted seed until a transaction replaces it in the work directory. The server does not re-verify the store; the compiler verifies it on build.
tools.name: xax_workspace
tools.title: XAX workspace

tools.description: PROTOTYPE: implements the root query only: the root bytes recorded in the current store's header and its byte size. The server does not re-verify the store (xax_build resolves it first). The bounded graph queries (functions, function_nodes, function_view, operands, neighborhood, uses, callers, callees, type, effects, effect_summary, entity, proof, diff, repair) are not implemented by the native server yet.
tools.name: xax_query
tools.title: XAX bounded query

tools.description: PROTOTYPE: constructs and verifies a NEW XAX program from one xax-construct-v1 carrier (typed semantic graph: types, functions of blocks of [operation, operands, result types, extra] nodes, package entries) by driving the host-granted native carrier decoder (XAX_MCP_CONSTRUCT) with a fixed argv. The carrier is transport; the verified canonical store it writes replaces the work directory's current store and the result reports its root and byte count. The decoder is a windows-x86_64 XAX program: a carrier that names another platform, needs an unimplemented feature, or is larger than the decoder's carrier limit is refused (construct_rejected), never partially encoded. Without XAX_MCP_CONSTRUCT and XAX_MCP_WORK the call fails closed. Candidate stores, rollback and handles for very large carriers are not implemented yet.
tools.name: xax_construct
tools.title: XAX construct

tools.description: PROTOTYPE: applies one XAXEDIT1 transaction carrier to the current store by driving the host-granted native XAX compiler's 'edit' command. 'record' is the carrier as a lowercase/uppercase hex string; the edited store replaces the work directory's current store and the result reports its new canonical root. Typed mutations, expected generation/root, candidates and rollback are not implemented yet.
tools.name: xax_transaction
tools.title: XAX transaction

tools.description: PROTOTYPE: resolves and builds the current store with the host-granted native XAX compiler ('resolve' then 'build'), writing snapshot/artifact/provenance into the host-granted work directory. Returns the canonical root, artifact byte count and the provenance object (byte count and hex). Artifact handles, entry/package selection, digest reports and toolchain caching are not implemented yet.
tools.name: xax_build
tools.title: XAX build

tools.description: PROTOTYPE: resolves and builds the current store, then runs that artifact inside the native OS sandbox and returns exit_code, duration_ms, flags (bit 0 timeout, bit 2 output truncated) and the artifact's stdout/stderr as hex. The sandbox is a capability-less Windows AppContainer inside a job object (fixed limits: 5 s CPU, 256 MiB, one process, 10 s wall, 1 MiB per stream); it ships beside the server as xax-mcp-sandbox.exe and is built from native/sandbox.py. Takes NO arguments yet: the artifact handle, input/output layout, argv, effects and per-call limits fail closed rather than being ignored; Linux namespaces and the xax-mcp-io-v1 framing are not implemented. Requires the host-granted execute right.
tools.name: xax_execute
tools.title: XAX execute

tools.description: UNIMPLEMENTED natively; calls fail closed with 'unsupported'. Target contract: fetch a bounded chunk of a large result by opaque handle: execution stdout (res_), a workspace's canonical store bytes (ws_), or a stored diagnostic (diag_). Never returns unbounded data.

tools.title: XAX result
